# Glossary

<!-- Written by build_glossary. Do not edit it here. -->

## Particulars

The claims an operator registers on a licence. A review can only contradict something on this list.

| particular | measured as | what it means | tolerance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lift` | flag | a passenger lift serves the guest floors |  |
| `step_free_entrance` | flag | the main entrance is step free |  |
| `en_suite_all` | flag | every let room is en suite |  |
| `breakfast_included` | flag | breakfast is in the room rate |  |
| `parking_on_site` | flag | parking is on the premises |  |
| `wifi_all_rooms` | flag | wireless internet reaches every room |  |
| `pets_accepted` | flag | dogs are accepted in let rooms |  |
| `late_arrival` | flag | arrival after ten at night is staffed |  |
| `let_rooms` | count | rooms let to guests |  |
| `bed_spaces` | count | bed spaces across all let rooms | 2 |
| `parking_spaces` | count | marked parking spaces | 1 |
| `shore_distance` | distance_m | walking metres to the shore | 150 |
| `station_distance` | distance_m | walking metres to the station | 250 |
| `grading_band` | band | the awarded grading band |  |

| --- |
